```{r four_method_document, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
study_root<-normalizePath(params$project_root,mustWork=TRUE)
canonical<-readLines(file.path(study_root,'reports/Kennedy_DRCMD_Simulation_Report.Rmd'))
frontmatter_end<-which(canonical=='---')[2]
body<-canonical[-seq_len(frontmatter_end)]
child_env<-new.env(parent=environment())
child_env$params<-list(project_root=study_root)
cat(knitr::knit_child(text=body,envir=child_env,quiet=TRUE),sep='\n')
```
